summary: Demis Hassabis announces SL2T, a sign-language-to-text model letting users sign directly to their phones, developed with the Deaf community.

practices.reason: A new model translates sign language to text, a multimodal capability, but no specifics on performance or architecture are given.
practices.quote: SL2T is our amazing sign-language-to-text model allows users to sign directly to their phones for the first time.
